pack.name: SOC 2 Type II (Architecture Themes)
pack.description: Trust Services Criteria architecture slice for security, availability, confidentiality, and processing integrity — logical access, encryption, change management, monitoring, and vendor risk themes. Thematic SOC 2 mapping only; not attestation or Type II audit evidence.

rules.title: Logical access restricted to authorized users
rules.description: Production systems must document how logical access is granted, reviewed, and revoked — role assignments should follow least privilege for operators and workloads.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document RBAC and entitlement models in governance.RequiredControls; cite Entra ID / subscription IAM exports from azureExtractor.manifest.ScopeDescriptor when inventory is present.

rules.title: Multi-factor authentication for privileged access
rules.description: Privileged access paths to production control planes and sensitive data stores must assume MFA or equivalent phishing-resistant controls.
rules.remediationGuidance: Record MFA expectations in governance.RequiredControls and governance.PolicyConstraints; tie identity-plane AuthenticatesWith edges to documented Conditional Access posture.

rules.title: Encryption protects data at rest
rules.description: Sensitive and customer data stores must document encryption-at-rest posture (platform-managed or customer-managed keys) appropriate to the trust services in scope.
rules.remediationGuidance: Align datastores[].Tags with encryption expectations; reference SQL TDE, Storage SSE, or Cosmos encryption from resources.json when extractor inventory accompanies the review.

rules.title: Encryption protects data in transit
rules.description: Service boundaries that move sensitive or customer data must document TLS or equivalent protections; legacy cleartext paths require explicit risk disposition.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document TLS minimums in governance.PolicyConstraints; align ReadsFrom/WritesTo relationship edges with HTTPS-only assumptions in metadata.ChangeDescription.

rules.title: Security monitoring and alerting documented
rules.description: Architecture must describe how security-relevant events are collected, correlated, and alerted — not merely that logs exist without operational response paths.
rules.remediationGuidance: Reference Log Analytics, Defender, or SIEM integration in services[].Tags and governance.RequiredControls; tie monitoring services to production workloads via relationship edges.

rules.title: Incident detection and response hooks
rules.description: Systems in scope should document how security incidents are detected, escalated, and contained — including on-call and runbook references at architecture level.
rules.remediationGuidance: Capture incident-response assumptions in governance.PolicyConstraints and metadata.ChangeDescription; link monitoring services to escalation paths.

rules.title: Availability objectives and fault tolerance documented
rules.description: When availability is in scope, architecture must state SLA/SLO targets, redundancy model, and single-points-of-failure disposition for critical paths.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document RTO/RPO and redundancy stance in governance.RequiredControls; correlate multi-region or zone resources from resources.json when extractor data is present.

frameworkMappings.theme: A1.1 — Availability commitments and system capacity

rules.title: Backup and recovery tested for critical data
rules.description: Stateful services must document backup cadence, retention, encryption, and restore-test expectations that support availability and confidentiality commitments.
rules.remediationGuidance: Align datastores[].Tags with backup narratives; document restore drills in governance.PolicyConstraints and metadata.ChangeDescription.

rules.title: Control environment and governance ownership
rules.description: Architecture documentation should identify accountable owners for security, availability, and change-control decisions — not anonymous platform teams.
rules.remediationGuidance: Record ownership and RACI themes in governance.RequiredControls and metadata.ChangeDescription; reference DecisionTraceIds when governance board decisions informed design.

rules.title: Security policies communicated to system owners
rules.description: System owners must be able to point to policy constraints that govern the workload — architecture metadata should mirror org security standards relevant to the service.
rules.remediationGuidance: Populate governance.PolicyConstraints with policy citations; align services[].RequiredControls with communicated standards.

frameworkMappings.theme: CC2.1 — Communication of objectives and responsibilities

rules.title: Risk assessment informs architecture choices
rules.description: Material risks (data sensitivity, threat exposure, third-party reliance) should be reflected in architecture decisions — not only in external risk registers disconnected from the manifest.
rules.remediationGuidance: Summarize key risks and mitigations in metadata.ChangeDescription; tag high-risk datastores and external dependencies in governance.ComplianceTags.

rules.title: Ongoing monitoring of control effectiveness
rules.description: Architecture should describe how control effectiveness is monitored over time — compliance scans, policy initiatives, or continuous control validation where applicable.
rules.remediationGuidance: Reference Azure Policy compliance exports (policy-compliance.json) when present; document recurring control checks in governance.RequiredControls.

rules.title: Change management for production systems
rules.description: Production changes must flow through documented approval, testing, and rollback paths — architecture should not assume direct-to-prod deployment without controls.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document CI/CD gates and approval workflows in governance.PolicyConstraints; tag deployment services with environment promotion model in services[].Tags.

rules.title: Segregation of duties in deployment paths
rules.description: The same principal should not unilaterally develop, approve, and deploy to production without compensating controls — separation themes must be documented.
rules.remediationGuidance: Describe SoD expectations in governance.RequiredControls; note break-glass exceptions with monitoring compensations in metadata.ChangeDescription.

rules.title: Vendor and subprocessors risk documented
rules.description: Third-party services that store, process, or transmit customer data must be enumerated with contractual and monitoring themes appropriate to SOC 2 vendor management.
rules.remediationGuidance: List vendor services in services[] with Purpose and vendor tags; document SOC/report reliance in governance.PolicyConstraints.

frameworkMappings.theme: CC9.1 — Risk mitigation through vendor management

rules.title: Access reviews for privileged roles
rules.description: Periodic access review cadence for privileged production roles must be documented — not assumed as an HR process outside architecture scope.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document access-review frequency and scope in governance.RequiredControls; cite IAM inventory freshness via azureExtractor.manifest.CollectionTimestamp.

rules.title: Secrets and key management lifecycle
rules.description: Cryptographic keys, certificates, and application secrets must use managed stores with rotation themes — not long-lived embedded credentials.
rules.remediationGuidance: Require Key Vault or platform secret surfaces on sensitive ReadsFrom/WritesTo paths; document rotation in governance.PolicyConstraints.

rules.title: Network segmentation for sensitive workloads
rules.description: Sensitive tiers should document network isolation — private endpoints, NSGs, or service endpoints — rather than implicit public reachability.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document segmentation intent in governance.PolicyConstraints; correlate private endpoint resources from resources.json when extractor inventory exists.

rules.title: Confidential data classification documented
rules.description: When confidentiality is in scope, data elements and stores should carry classification tags that drive access, encryption, and retention controls.
rules.remediationGuidance: Apply classification tags on datastores[].Tags and governance.ComplianceTags; link handling rules in governance.PolicyConstraints.

rules.title: Processing integrity inputs and outputs defined
rules.description: When processing integrity is in scope, systems should document expected inputs, validations, and outputs so completeness and accuracy can be assessed at architecture level.
rules.remediationGuidance: Describe processing boundaries and validation points in services[].Purpose and metadata.ChangeDescription; tag pipelines with integrity controls in services[].Tags.

rules.title: Capacity and performance monitoring
rules.description: Availability commitments require documented capacity planning and performance monitoring — autoscale rules or manual capacity review cadence.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document scale thresholds and monitoring dashboards in governance.RequiredControls; reference compute SKU choices from resources.json when sizing is inventoried.

rules.title: Disaster recovery failover tested
rules.description: Multi-region or standby architectures must document failover testing cadence and last successful drill themes — not only theoretical DR diagrams.
rules.remediationGuidance: Record DR test outcomes or planned cadence in metadata.ChangeDescription; align region pairs with resources.json location fields.

rules.title: Vulnerability management for deployable assets
rules.description: Container images, VMs, and application packages should document vulnerability scanning and patch cadence before production promotion.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document scan gates in governance.PolicyConstraints; tag build pipelines and registries in services[].Tags.

rules.title: Audit log retention and integrity
rules.description: Security and administrative audit logs must have documented retention, immutability or WORM themes, and restricted access — supporting monitoring and investigation.
rules.remediationGuidance: Specify log retention in governance.RequiredControls; reference centralized log sinks in services[].Purpose.

rules.title: Environment separation (dev/test/prod)
rules.description: Non-production environments must not share production data or credentials without documented compensating controls and network isolation.
rules.remediationGuidance: Tag environment class on services[].Tags and subscriptions in governance.ComplianceTags; document data sanitisation for lower environments.

rules.title: Data disposal and end-of-life handling
rules.description: Architecture should describe how customer data is deleted or anonymised at end of retention or contract termination across primary stores and backups.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document disposal procedures in governance.PolicyConstraints; flag long-retention archives that extend confidentiality exposure.

rules.title: Configuration baseline and drift detection
rules.description: Production configuration should have documented baselines and drift detection — policy initiatives, desired-state IaC, or configuration scanners.
rules.remediationGuidance: Reference IaC sources and policy compliance exports; document baseline ownership in governance.RequiredControls.

rules.title: Business continuity dependencies mapped
rules.description: Critical external dependencies (identity, DNS, payment, messaging) must be enumerated with failure modes and continuity assumptions.
rules.remediationGuidance: List dependency services in services[] with failure-impact notes in Purpose; document fallback or degraded modes in metadata.ChangeDescription.
